caption: The drawing consists of a single large black symbol centered on a plain, off-white background. The symbol is composed of thick, straight and curved lines that intersect and form an abstract shape. The top portion is a horizontal black line with short perpendicular ends. A vertical black line descends from the center of the horizontal line, extending downward. There is a shorter diagonal line attached to the left side of the vertical line, slanting downward to the left. The base of the vertical line transitions into a thick, sweeping curve that extends toward the left and then curves back to the right, terminating with an upward curl at the right end. The composition uses only black and white colors, with no additional objects or details in the background.
